title: Case 048: Bathroom Window Repair Request
initial_request: Bathroom window will not open -please can you fix
overview: The tenant reported that the bathroom window would not open. Northbridge Lettings obtained landlord approval, assigned Riverside Solutions, and arranged a visit. The provider reported replacing the handle, gearbox, and hinges because of multiple faults. The request was closed after the final checks were completed.
outcome: Riverside Solutions confirmed the window repair was completed, with the handle, gearbox, and hinges replaced.
